document.note: [Secret, Noforn] Unnamed and undated, this document confirms Pakistan provides the Taliban with financial and military assistance. It speculates Pakistan will pressure the Taliban to moderate some policies out of fear of Pashtun irredentism. It also says Russia pledged military force if the Taliban push north and that India supplies weapons to anti-Taliban forces.

sources_cited: Reports cited for India's aid to anti-Taliban forces
key_claims: Pakistan provides both military and financial assistance to the Taliban.
Pakistan's goals are strategic depth against India and access to Central Asian trade routes.
Pakistan fears a complete Taliban victory could inflame Pashtun irredentism and will likely pressure the Taliban to moderate.
Russia sees the Taliban as a major threat and has pledged military force if they push into northern Afghanistan.
Uzbekistan supports Dostam's ethnic Uzbek Junbish faction.
Tajikistan has recently begun sending supplies and ammunition to anti-Taliban forces.
India is reportedly supplying weapons and other aid to anti-Taliban forces.
